quarterly_data.quarter: Sumitomo Bakelite press release: Summary of Consolidated Business Results for the Three (08-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q1 FY2026 (three months ended June 30, 2026, IFRS): revenue rose 22.6% year over year to ¥95,211 million on higher sales volume primarily from growing semiconductor demand, sales-price optimization and the weaker yen; business profit rose 51.2% to ¥13,625 million despite a surge in raw material prices due to the situation in the Middle East; operating profit rose 65.4% to ¥14,218 million. Semiconductor materials segment: revenue ¥34,210 million (up 40.0%), business profit ¥8,014 million (up 66.3%), revenue increased significantly on demand related to AI data centers, with particularly strong growth in power device applications. Company: epoxy molding compounds for encapsulation saw strong demand in power device, high-end smartphone, telecom and automotive semiconductor applications, with Chinese demand expanding on policies promoting domestic semiconductor production; photosensitive materials grew on memory demand; bonding pastes grew in power device applications including power management ICs; semiconductor substrate materials revenue grew for embedded component substrates used in power device applications.
quarterly_data.figure: Revenue ¥95,211 million (+22.6%); semiconductor materials revenue ¥34,210 million (+40.0%), business profit ¥8,014 million (+66.3%)
